changes: Conforming alpha-border refinement of mixed cells; target edge size 2–32 px; base budget 3968 vertices reserving room for inserted pin handles below the 4096 ARAP limit
Real 2D local/global ARAP; positive uniform edge weights; sparse diagonally preconditioned CG; exact inserted handle vertices; legacy advanced.ts Laplacian solver unchanged
MLS/ARAP controls in the existing Slint Puppet panel; radius/weight apply only to MLS; GUI migration deferred
Shared deformed geometry packet for texture, wireframe, onion skin and export; deterministic rest-start solves; four-pose cache invalidated by geometry/UV/pin-rest signature
Per-mesh build/deformation settings persisted and restored by document history; rebuild retains mode/skinning/strength; prevalidation rejects invalid ARAP budgets before document mutation

vitest.verification_note: Final complete suite passed all 267 tests in 26 suites; global typecheck, build and strict typechecks for both native QA scripts passed.

solver_benchmark.scope: Pure solve() latency after preparation and one warmup; excludes native UI, rasterization, export, solver construction, pin insertion and packet pose cache
solver_benchmark.caveat: Cloud latency can vary with concurrent work; bounded iterations do not prove full convergence and do not predict full-frame FPS

limitations: CPU renderer and solver; no 60 FPS guarantee for dense meshes or hardware acceptance
Uniform positive weights, not cotangents; no collision/self-intersection or area-conservation guarantee
Pins outside mesh triangles do not deform; coincident fixed anchors take priority; locks are image-local, not world IK
Cell approximation preserves original texture alpha, not exact geometric holes/island separation
YouTube URLs returned HTTP 403; videos were not watched or transcribed
Blend, smoothing, paths, advanced BBW/cage integration and GUI migration remain outside this increment
